thread:
Alex: CI publish blocked for @sdk-js — semver guard rejected the release because regendiff detected changes in generated types. job: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/789 :grimacing:
Maya: looked into the logs, failure is 'typegen mismatch: generated types differ from committed stubs' — looks like parameter ordering changed in the generated client
Sam: we changed the openapi->codegen mapping last week, might be the culprit. Did anyone run a full regendiff before the bump? :eyes:
Rene: quick check: the OpenAPI generator started sorting properties by schema name after that patch. That will change signature ordering even if semantics are same. Not safe for users
Maya: reproduced locally with `yarn typegen:diff` — snippet:
```
- export function createWidget(opts: { size?: number; name: string }): Widget
+ export function createWidget(opts: { name: string; size?: number }): Widget
```
Sam: oof. That breaks sample-apps tests because some tests relied on positional destructuring in JS examples. This is definitely a semver-affecting change
ci-bot: build #789 failed: sample-apps/unit (1/12) — logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/789/consoleText
Alex: short-term unblock plan: (1) revert the release semver bump so publish is blocked, (2) run full typegen regen and commit updated stubs, (3) add a prepublish `typegen:check` gate to CI. Thoughts?
Rene: alternative: permit codegen-only minor bumps and auto-commit regendiff, but that hides user-facing ordering changes. I'd rather explicit review
Maya: agree with Rene — auto-commit caused a surprise last quarter. Human review + changelog entry noting generator template changes is better for auditing
Sam: I'll open a hotfix PR to pin property ordering in the generator templates and add the `yarn typegen:check` step to `ci/publish.yml`. Will also add a release checklist item to run sample-apps after typegen
Alex: please tag me on the PR. Once tests pass we'll re-run the publish job. Also let's add a CONTRIBUTING note about generator-induced semver impacts so the release engineer is alerted
Maya: created a minimal changelog blurb suggestion for the release notes explaining the typegen reorder and recommended migration notes for integrators
Sam: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/812 — contains generator pin + CI gate. Requesting quick review from @Alex and @Rene
Alex: reviewing now, thanks. If green, we can merge and rerun the CI job. :+1:
